name: show-file-transfer
description: Show an owner file picker/download card for target and remotePath. Without card rendering, use packaged portal-files for PC bytes. This tool cannot read PC paths.

portalRules.outputSchema: server.mjs:48-49 transferOutput = z.object({ transfer, uiEnabled, maxBytes }).strict() with transfer strict. Not the Contract 2.0 envelope. Result-level _meta.sshApproval keys (server.mjs:54-59): bridgeDisplayName, targetDisplayName, [targetId, targetRevision, targets], uiEnabled, namespace, maxBytes, chunkBytes, webUrl, [bootstrapTicket when uiEnabled].
portalRules._meta: _meta.ui.resourceUri is computed at runtime: `ui://ssh-approval/card-${hash(uiHtml)}.html`, hash = SHA-256 hex (server.mjs:15, validation.mjs:5). The literal above is a template, not a fixed value.
portalRules.inputSchema: server.mjs:51 handler validates remotePath with remotePath() (POSIX targets) or windowsRemotePath() (Windows targets) from domain/validation.mjs; the exact path grammar is not transcribed here (see baseline: unverified). Failure => thrown error => generic refused() text.

ui.resourceUri: ui://ssh-approval/card-{sha256 hex of the card HTML}.html
